_schema.purpose: Lightweight model-to-guide index for /analyze-then-pick. The command reads ONLY this file to build the model menu, then loads ONLY the selected model's guide.

fields.name: display name
fields.guide: path relative to the library root (analyze-then-pick/)
fields.status: active | limited (works with caveats) | legacy (superseded; may be served by another backend) | retired (not in live catalog)
fields.modes: analyze = can create new videos; edit = can transform a supplied video (edit_kind says how)
fields.operations: t2v, start_frame, end_frame, image_refs, video_refs, audio_refs, elements, video_edit, video_extension, object_replace, motion_transfer, multi_shot, native_audio
fields.duration_s: allowed durations (range string or list); edit ids follow the source
fields.text_rendering: how far in-frame text can be trusted (see guide 3.11); default policy = clean plate + deterministic captions
fields.output_9x16_720p: params that give vertical 9:16 at 720p on this id, the expected pixels, and the post step (atp.py conform) or input requirement
fields.best_for / avoid_for: one-line routing hints for the model menu
fields.continuation: how a video longer than one generation is built (generation-system.md §3b): max_s = longest single generation on Higgsfield; continuous = ranked methods for a seam inside one continuous take (extension | video_continuation | keyframe_ladder | last_frame | cut_only | segments); note = model-specific facts. Seams on the reference's own cuts are always preferred, whatever the model

_schema.add_a_model: Copy an entry, point 'guide' at a new file made from models/_TEMPLATE.md. The command needs no change.

menu.note: The model menu always lists EVERY available video model in this order (pinned first); live models missing from the index are appended with a fallback note. Edit the order here — the command needs no change.

seedance_2_5.name: Seedance 2.5
seedance_2_5.duration_s: 4-30 (edit: follows source, billed by source length)
seedance_2_5.text_rendering: subtitle notation exists (【】); treat exact text as unreliable -> clean plate + post captions

output_9x16_720p.post: verify; frames: exactly 9:16 images with aspect_ratio auto; edit/extension: source reframed to 9:16 first

seedance_2_5.best_for: Default general model: multi-reference (up to 50 refs), long clips up to 30 s, reference video as motion/camera driver, precise edits, extensions
seedance_2_5.avoid_for: Nothing specific; draft mode finalizes at 1080p only

continuation.note: mode video_extension + extension_mode forward; @Video1 = the accepted clip by job id (input 2-30 s); duration = the new part; ByteDance's example returns ONLY the new part and its first frame repeats the input's last (concat continuous seam drops it) - ffprobe the first result to confirm on Higgsfield; <=2 extension hops per take; start_image cannot mix with image references upstream: in omni mode write 'Use @ImageN as the first frame.'

output_9x16_720p.post: source reframed to 9:16 first; restore-audio; conform; qc

ad_multiplier.best_for: Edit Mode swaps of people/products/objects in a 4-30 s clip following Higgsfield's first-party edit contract

continuation.note: same surface as seedance_2_5; Higgsfield's edit-variant wrapper - prefer seedance_2_5 for new clips
